title: Datavault AI stock plummets 50% after firm says it cannot withdraw bitcoin tied to $150 million deal
summary: The issue centers on a deal with Scilex, under which Scilex agreed to buy shares of Datavault AI for $150 million, payable in bitcoin.

title: Moody’s assigns investment-grade ratings to Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin
summary: Moody's Ratings assigned the RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term ratings, citing credit quality and market value of its reserve assets.

title: Ripple expects $900 million annualized product revenue run rate as institutional business expands
summary: Ripple expects a $900M annualized product revenue run rate by end of 2026, as RLUSD reaches $2.5B and payments near $150B in lifetime volume.

title: Crypto braces for potential shift in congressional oversight after midterms
summary: Post-Clarity Act, the crypto sector could find itself navigating a very different political landscape under a new Congress.

title: Avail launches ShieldTX privacy tool targeting copy-trading bots on Hyperliquid
summary: Avail launched ShieldTX, a Hyperliquid privacy tool that creates a separate wallet for each perpetual futures position.

title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
summary: RLUSD is live on Coinbase with 1:1 USD conversion on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base, capping a big week of news for Ripple.

title: Bitwise raises bitcoin price target to $1.6 million by 2036, projects 34% annualized returns
summary: Bitwise's bear case puts bitcoin at $130,686 by 2036, while its bull case reaches $3.67 million over the next decade.

title: Robinhood earnings miss, crypto weakness fail to shake Wall Street’s bullish outlook
summary: Bernstein sees Robinhood’s crypto business shifting toward infrastructure as new products like prediction markets and perps gain ground.
